relevance_note: Single case report of an infant with a clinical (CT angiography) diagnosis of arterial tortuosity syndrome: 'we present a case of arterial tortuosity syndrome diagnosed with preoperative CT angiography'; no SLC2A10 testing is reported, so the variants table is empty.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; JSON assembled by a short script in scratch. In scope: the index infant (diagnosis of ATS, label 'patient' by rule 5) and his affected brother ('brother of patient', significant tortuosity of the aortic arch and thoracic aorta). Parents (consanguineous, untested, unaffected) and the other sibling get no rows. No genetic testing or SLC2A10 variant is reported for anyone, so the variants table is empty and n_patients_reported is null. Contradiction: the patient is described as having '2 previous healthy children' as siblings, yet his brother was found to have significant aortic tortuosity after a heart murmur; recorded the brother's features as stated and no exclusions from 'healthy'. Normal chest X-ray and normal echocardiographic heart structure/function recorded as excluded only for what they name (D-27); they exclude no specific checklist item. Kinking of the aortic arch was not called stenosis, so stenosis is not reported. Onset of vomiting is given only relative to admission ('8 days before admission'), so individual age at onset is not reported; '4-week-old' is age at presentation, recorded as age at last evaluation. Vital status 'alive' from 'the patient recovered uneventfully'. Ethnicity 'Iranian' from the authors' statement about 'our case'; not applied to the brother.
